name: io.github.cyanheads/stackexchange-mcp-server
description: Search Stack Exchange questions, fetch Q&A threads as markdown, look up tag FAQs and user profiles.

environmentVariables.name: STACKEXCHANGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Stack Exchange API key — lifts per-IP quota from ~300/day to ~10,000/day. Register at https://stackapps.com/apps/oauth/register.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
